svg.desc: Exploratory example-session C1 repeat comparison, separate from Supplementary Figure 7. A-D: matched 90-degree single presentations, 45-degree singles, halt, and omission, respectively. All panels use the same 203 eligible visual SUA from mouse 830794's January 27, 2026 session and Figure 9's frozen context-only Rastermap row order, without Q1/Q2 filtering or event-specific cell selection. Difference definition: (post-C1 trial-mean SDF - post-C1 per-unit grey display baseline) minus (pre-C1 trial-mean SDF - pre-C1 per-unit grey display baseline). Baselines pool complete half-open 20-ms preceding-grey bins. Each unit's pre/post SDF uses the same included trials as its baseline. SDFs use 5-ms bins, a causal 25-ms exponential kernel, and -0.75 to +0.75 seconds relative to event onset. Each event has 34 pre and 34 post presentations, except 45 degrees: the first presentation in each C1 repeat lacks a preceding-grey baseline and is explicitly excluded, leaving 33 pre and 33 post. No baseline is borrowed or imputed. Top: post-minus-pre heatmaps with one shared +/-21 Hz color limit, the ceiling of the pooled absolute 99th percentile across all four maps; samples beyond the limit saturate. Dashed lines mark onset; black bars mark the median nominal event window, capped at the displayed window. Bottom: mean unitwise difference (purple) and across-neuron SEM (shading), all on +/-5 Hz axes. Mean and sample SD (ddof=1)/sqrt(n) of unitwise post-minus-pre differences; same units in every event, not independently combined pre/post SEMs. This is descriptive across-neuron uncertainty, not trial or mouse uncertainty or a significance test. These are event types in C1 controls, not actual oddball-context deviants. The comparison does not isolate temporal drift or prediction error. Existing S7 figures and Q1/Q2 classifications are unchanged.
svg.title: Four-event C1 differences: post minus pre
